for package in ("certifi", "charset_normalizer", "idna", "chardet"):
    to_be_imported = package
    if package == "chardet":
        to_be_imported = "charset_normalizer"
    elif package == "urllib3":
        to_be_imported = "urllib3_future"
    try:
        __import__(to_be_imported)
    except ImportError:
        continue


def check_library_availability():
    libraries = {
        "pymupdf": "fitz",
        "pypdf": "pypdf",
        "pikepdf": "pikepdf",
        "borb": "borb",
    }
    for name, import_name in libraries.items():
        try:
            __import__(import_name)
        except ImportError:
            continue
